scope.reviewed: two separate original code spans, wrapped arithmetic leaf and caller update ordering, including distinct buffers and tested weights

findings.result: Independent decode confirms the 16-byte 4FDE leaf computes two 32-bit MULS products, adds with 32-bit wrap, then logical-shifts right 8; the caller supplies weight as R2, and the leaf returns R0 with R2 preserved.

The 68-byte 49E6 caller saves current halfwords before reading config word112, extracts weight bits 16..23, and gates history updates on config bit1. When enabled it calls 4FDE separately for each current/history halfword pair, stores each result to history before updating current; otherwise it copies the saved pair to current without touching history. Other entry bytes remain unchanged. R4-R8 and SP restore; R0 is incidental.

Receipt/source/body/artifact hashes match, and an isolated run of all 2,813 cases produced replay JSON byte-identical to the candidate. It covers 253 full-width arithmetic triples and 2,560 caller cases over every byte weight, both gates, and five halfword pairs.

limitations: Fixtures keep current and history in separate buffers; aliasing and concurrent mutation remain untested.
Only the listed operands/weights are covered; no physical field meaning or wider caller contract is established.
No canonical admission or C implementation.
